#!name=BoxJs
#!desc=http://boxjs.com
#!author=ChavyLeung
#!homepage=https://docs.boxjs.app/
#!category=BoxJs

[General]
force-http-engine-hosts = %APPEND% boxjs.com, boxjs.net, *.boxjs.com, *.boxjs.net

[Script]
Rewrite: BoxJs = type=http-request,pattern=^https?:\/\/(?:[A-Za-z0-9-]+\.)*boxjs\.(?:com|net)(?=\/|$),script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chavyleung/scripts/bfab3c906f3d5d126e9094f15730e025f7f32128/box/chavy.boxjs.js, requires-body=true, timeout=120

[MITM]
hostname = %INSERT% boxjs.com, boxjs.net, *.boxjs.com, *.boxjs.net
